card.name: Linking words before a second person or group
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "and" right after a noun for a person (son, compatriot, predecessor) when a second role follows. Also scattered small words like "as", "in", "to" or a closing bracket before a following noun phrase.

modes.label: and between roles
modes.description: "and" joins two roles held by the same or related person, such as son and successor.
modes.example: Gustav III's son<< and>> successor, Gustav IV Adolf.
